collection.title: Hyundai i20 2009 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Hyundai i20 Hatchback 2009 to 2014 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, we also have rear blade for this i20, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
